title: Judgment
description: What the judgment pass produces. A separate file from the review document, so the LLM cannot touch stage 1 data. groups, path, reasons and riskAdjustments may be omitted when there is nothing to say; the merge treats a missing section as empty.

reasons.description: One plain sentence per hunk id, capped at 200 characters by the merge.

JudgmentGroup.title: JudgmentGroup
JudgmentGroup.description: A proposed group without id or producedBy; the merge assigns both. collapsedByDefault defaults to false for a scrutinize group and true for a skim group.

JudgmentPathStep.title: JudgmentPathStep
JudgmentPathStep.description: A step without a number; the order in the array is the order. A group ref names a stage 1 group id. A proposed group is placed where the first of its hunks is referenced.

JudgmentRiskAdjustment.title: JudgmentRiskAdjustment
JudgmentRiskAdjustment.description: A proposed level for one hunk. A level at or below the hunk's floor is dropped and logged.

JudgmentSummary.title: JudgmentSummary
JudgmentSummary.description: counts are recomputed by the merge and are not part of the judgment.
